libs.note: BH-8150: the fleet's own GitHub writes (labels, comments, PR state, queue requests, pushes) in bin/lib/mc/*.sh, bin/merge-queue.sh and bin/lib/rb/pr.sh update the PR record (bin/lib/pr-record.sh) after GitHub answered rc 0, from what GitHub answered. prr_write wraps each write; prr_note_push follows a push. Log: logs/pr-record.log, one `write <repo>#<n> <kind> put=failed` line per failed record write.

knobs.zero_means: no PR-record write from a GitHub write or a push; GitHub writes run as before
knobs.note: 1 = each successful fleet GitHub write also writes the PR record (one jobs request). Read through lane_knob (libs scope) when the caller has it, else as ${PR_RECORD_WRITES:-1}; a value that is not 0 or 1 is 1 and one logs/pr-record.log line names it.
